Vendor profile

IronCAD LLC

IronCAD LLC — Innovator of Dual-Kernel (ACIS + Parasolid) Drag-and-Drop TriBall 3D Modeling & Native DWG Detailing (CAXA)

By GstarCAD Academy Engineering Editorial Board (Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.) Reviewed by GstarCAD Academy Editorial Team Last reviewed 2026-10-26 Editorial Process

1. Atlanta Engineering Innovation: Trispectives, TriBall & Dual-Kernel Architecture

Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and established in 2001 following the merger of Visionary Design Systems and 3D/Eye (creators of Trispectives), IronCAD LLC pioneered catalog-driven drag-and-drop 3D design and the iconic TriBall™ 3D positioning manipulator. IronCAD allows mechanical equipment builders to assemble modular conveyor lines, packaging machinery, and sheet-metal enclosures without fighting fragile parent-child constraint rebuild errors.

2. The Industry's Only Simultaneous ACIS + Parasolid Dual-Kernel Modeler

IronCAD's defining technical architecture is its Collaborative Dual-Kernel Engine: both Spatial ACIS and Siemens Parasolid reside simultaneously inside the same `.ics` scene file. If a complex variable-radius fillet or shell operation fails on a part using Parasolid, the engineer can switch that specific part's kernel to ACIS on the fly—Dramatically reducing geometry healing overhead when importing multi-vendor STEP/IGES supplier catalogs.

3. Enterprise 2D Mechanical Documentation with GstarCAD Mechanical

For automated factory layout engineering, pneumatic/hydraulic schematics, and standardized ISO/DIN 2D assembly drawings, IronCAD users pair their 3D `.ics` models with GstarCAD Mechanical 2027 and FastView 3D to achieve enterprise-wide DWG standardization and automated ERP BOM extraction.

5. Enterprise Co-Existence, Migration & TCO Optimization Protocol

In production supply chains where upstream 3D models or BIM containers originate from IronCAD LLC (Atlanta, GA, USA) platforms, engineering IT directors optimize total cost of ownership (TCO) by deploying a tiered seat architecture centered on GstarCAD 2027 and DWG FastView:

  • Verified Data Exchange Pipeline: Export modular 3D machinery scenes (.ics) to STEP AP242 for FastView 3D review, and standardize factory floor layouts and pneumatic/electrical schematics in GstarCAD Mechanical 2027.
  • Eliminating Redundant Seat Rentals: Rather than purchasing high-cost authoring subscriptions for project managers, site engineers, estimators, CNC operators, and quality inspectors who primarily review geometry or annotate 2D DWG/DXF sheets, organizations equip 70%–80% of their workforce with GstarCAD Perpetual Floating Licenses (GstarLM) and FastView 3D.
  • Automated Database Hygiene Before Transmittal: Prior to archiving project deliverables or importing external vendor DWG exports into corporate PDM/CDE vaults, run GstarCAD's batch script sequence (-PURGE RegApps → OVERKILL → AUDIT Yes → INDEXCTL = 3) to guarantee sub-second opening times and zero proxy object corruption.
